title: Neighborhood Serve Day
description: Hands-on projects around Glendale — painting, meals, and yard work for neighbors who need a hand. All ages welcome; lunch provided.

title: Baptism Sunday & Potluck
description: Our biggest celebration of the season — we baptize new believers during the service, then share a potluck lunch under the oaks. Bring a dish and a friend.

title: Newcomer Dinner
description: A relaxed dinner for anyone new to I AM. Meet a pastor, ask your questions, and find your first step. Childcare provided — just let us know.

title: Vacation Bible Camp
description: A week of games, songs, crafts, and story for kindergarten through 5th grade. Registration opens in June and fills fast — reserve a spot early.

title: Night of Worship
description: An unhurried evening of song, Scripture, and quiet prayer. No sermon, no rush — just space to be still together as the week begins.

title: Home Groups Kickoff
description: The church gets small around living-room tables. Find a group near you for the fall term — food, friendship, and honest conversation every week.

title: Connections
description: New here? This is the easiest way to meet people and find your next step at I AM.

title: Young Adults
description: Faith, friendship, and figuring life out — with people in the same season.
leader: Led by the Young Adults Team

title: Kids
description: A safe, fun place for kids to grow in their faith alongside their friends.

title: Mens Group
description: Coffee, honest talk, and working through a book of the Bible together.

title: Womens Group
description: A warm community of women encouraging each other through every season of life.

weekendLede: Doors open thirty minutes early for coffee. Come as you are — kids' check-in runs the whole service.
